facts.fact: A study by Catherine G. Mkude of the Open University of Tanzania evaluated 42 Tanzanian e-government websites against WCAG 2.2 using SortSite, finding an average of 3.64 pages per site with accessibility errors, mostly Level A, with the National Identification Authority portal fully compliant and the NHIF service portal widely non-conformant.

TZA.note: The document gives only a count of over 500 websites and national digital services, not services completed online or a portal.
